name: Tongji University
summary: Shanghai university with seven English-taught international first degrees in built environments, transport, management and medicine.

ib.text: High-school graduation, school results and CSCA are required; IB results may supplement the file. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 85, with waivers for English-medium schooling/native speakers. No IB minimum is published.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering (International Class)
programmes.about: Civil engineering study of buildings, bridges, underground structures and infrastructure, with technical design and construction applications.
programmes.overview: Civil Engineering develops the scientific and technical foundations used in structures and infrastructure. The college describes building, bridge, underground, geotechnical, railway and road engineering among the areas of study. Students connect engineering theory with design, construction and the analysis of engineering problems. The international class provides an English-taught route into this discipline.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Physics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Architecture (International Class)
programmes.about: A four-year English-taught architecture degree blending architectural design studios, history and theory, construction technology and practical fieldwork.
programmes.overview: Students study design fundamentals and architectural design studios alongside architectural history, theory, and urban analysis. Technical teaching covers building construction, materials, physics, professional codes and disaster prevention. The published 2026 course outline includes art workshops, measured surveys of historic buildings and a final graduation design project. The exact sequencing of these elements should be confirmed against the curriculum issued for the student’s entry year.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Physics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programmes.about: A six-year first-entry MBBS taught in English, combining biomedical science, clinical medicine, clinical placements and Chinese-language study.
programmes.overview: The programme begins with biomedical foundations including anatomy, physiology, biochemistry and pathology, followed by clinical disciplines such as internal medicine, surgery and paediatrics. The 2026 curriculum includes laboratory teaching, extended clinical practice, a graduation examination, Chinese language and professional Chinese courses. While the degree is advertised as English-taught, the working language of each clinical placement is not fully specified. Applicants should verify medical licensing and degree recognition in their intended country of practice.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Chemistry in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Urban and Rural Planning (International Class)
programmes.about: Urban and rural planning study connecting the design and management of settlements with geography, society, infrastructure and the environment.
programmes.overview: The department combines planning theory with design and practical experience. Its curriculum spans urban geography, sociology and economics, environmental protection, infrastructure and the history of urban development. Planning and design studios develop spatial and analytical skills alongside the study of cities and regions. The 2027 international class offers an English-taught route into this field.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Physics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Landscape Architecture (International Class)
programmes.about: Landscape planning and design linking ecological restoration, garden design, heritage, construction and the use of plants in outdoor spaces.
programmes.overview: Landscape Architecture studies the relationship between people, settlements and natural environments. The published undergraduate subject areas include landscape and garden design, ecology and regeneration, heritage conservation and landscape engineering. Courses in planting, green-space systems and landscape resources connect design with environmental knowledge. The 2027 international class is taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Physics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Traffic Engineering (International Class)
programmes.about: A traffic engineering degree within a college spanning roads, railways, airports and transport information engineering.
programmes.overview: Traffic Engineering is part of Tongji's wider land-transportation education. Its subject background brings together road, railway and airport engineering with traffic and transport-information engineering. The college emphasises comprehensive study and an international perspective rather than one isolated transport mode. The 2027 international class provides a four-year English-taught first-degree route.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics and Physics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

programmes.name: Project Management (International Class)
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary management degree joining engineering technology with construction-project and real-estate management.
programmes.overview: The Project Management major combines engineering technology and management. The school describes two directions: engineering-project management and real-estate operation and management. Its focus covers the whole process of construction projects and the development and management of real estate. The 2027 international class provides a four-year English-taught route into this subject.
programmes.selectionNote: CSCA results, academic-document review and an online college interview; Architecture also requires supplementary professional materials.
programmes.ib: CSCA Mathematics in English is required; this is separate from IB subjects. No IB subject-level equivalence is published.

notes: International applicants need foreign nationality; additional nationality and residence evidence applies to some applicants with Chinese family or former nationality.
Apply for one major. Shortlisted applicants attend an online interview; provisional admission requires first-year tuition payment within two weeks.
Architecture requires supplementary professional materials. The architecture/planning college excludes applicants with colour blindness or colour weakness; check the official conditions.
